input_location.description: The type of input being supplied. Accepted values are "remote_url" and "supplied".

auto_parse.description: Should we begin parsing the job immediately? (default: false)

auto_start.description: Should we run the job immediately after being parsed? (default: false)

run_sample.description: Should this job be run as a sample? (default: false)

filename.description: This will be what's displayed in the dashboard when viewing this job

leverage_historical_data.description: Control historical data usage, set to false to use real-time only verification

allow_manual_review.description: Denotes whether or not the job should be allowed to fall into manual review

callback_url.description: An optional URL that we should send events to during the lifecycle of the job

callback_headers.description: An optional array of headers that should be included when sending events to the callback_url
